headword: {準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}
gloss: preparation complete; all set; ready to go

definitions.gloss: preparation complete; all set; ready to go
definitions.explanation: the state of having finished all necessary preparations

examples.japanese: {準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}。⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{始|はじ}められます。
examples.english: Preparations are complete. We can start anytime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I confirmed that preparations for departure were complete.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: We'll start the meeting once everyone is ready.

notes:
A concise compound often used as a status report or announcement. Common in both spoken and written Japanese, from casual situations to military and business operations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}です: preparations are complete (polite)
- {準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧: to report that preparations are complete
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧{準備完了|じゅんびかんりょう}: launch preparations complete

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用意|ようい}→用意：01746_youi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: ready, prepared — more casual and spoken
- スタンバイ⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: standby complete — uses the English loanword, common in technical or broadcast contexts
- ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧: systems are in order, ready — more formal and often used for organizational readiness

REGISTER:
Neutral. Used across contexts from casual to formal. Especially common in status updates, checklists, and operational communication.
